The work we do matters! 
 Hiring Agency: 
Health & Human Services - Agency 25 
 Location: 
Lincoln, NE 
 Hiring Rate: 
$36.060 
 Job Posting: 
JR2026-00030218 Cloud Stack Developer (Azure) - TechArch (Open) 
 Applications No Longer Accepted On (If no date is displayed, job is posted as open until closed): 
11-07-2026 
 Job Description: 
Are you a quick learner? Are you detail oriented, organized, and a good problem solver? Do you like routine but yet embrace variety? Are you a team player and customer-service oriented? Consider joining our team!

Nebraska DHHS is seeking a skilled Cloud Stack Developer with strong experience in Microsoft Azure to design, develop, and maintain modern, scalable applications. This role requires full-stack development expertise using Spring Boot (backend), React (frontend), and SQL Server (database).

We offer an excellent total compensation package including: 13 paid holidays, immediate earning of vacation and sick leave; state-matched (156%) retirement plan; health (79% employer contribution), dental, vision, and life insurance options, and we are a qualifying employer for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program.
 

The State of Nebraska is value driven, and these values are at the core of everything we do: Treating others with dignity & respect – ethically sound – customer is always the priority


***This is a full-time/permanent on-site role in Lincoln, Nebraska. Not eligible to be a contracted position. 
 
 **The Nebraska Department of Health and Human Services does not sponsor STEM (form i-983) or non-immigrant work visas for this position.** 


 Examples of Work 

 Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications using Spring Boot, React, and MS SQL Server
 Develop and expose RESTful APIs to support internal and external system integrations
 Build responsive and user-friendly front-end interfaces using React
 Design and develop reports and data-driven dashboards using SQL Server and reporting tools
 Implement secure authentication and authorization using Azure AD B2C
 Deploy and manage applications using Azure services (App Services, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, etc.)
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams including architects, QA, and business stakeholders
 Participate in Agile development processes using JIRA for task tracking and sprint planning
 Optimize application performance, scalability, and security
 Troubleshoot and resolve production issues and support release deployments
 

 Requirements / Qualifications: 
 Minimum Qualifications: A bachelor’s degree or equivalent in computer science, information systems, mathematics, engineering or other related field and two years of experience, education, or training in coding computer applications; programming experience can be substituted for education on a year for year basis.

 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
 5+ years of experience in full-stack application development
 Strong experience with Spring Boot (Java) for backend development
 Strong experience with React for front-end development
 Proficiency in SQL Server including query development and performance tuning
 Experience developing RESTful APIs and microservices
 Experience working with Microsoft Azure cloud services
 Understanding of secure coding practices and authentication mechanisms
 Strong problem-solving and communication skills
 Experience with Azure AD B2C for identity and access management
 Experience using JIRA for Agile project tracking
 Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
 Experience with reporting tools (Power BI, SSRS, or similar)
 Experience in public sector or healthcare environments is a plus
 
 Other:  Position is located on-site at the Nebraska State Office Building in Lincoln. No remote or hybrid work.

 Hours: Monday – Friday (business hours) with occasional off hours support.
 
 
 
 
 If you're currently employed by the State of Nebraska, please don't apply through this external career site. Instead, log in to Workday and open the Jobs Hub - Internal Apply app from your home landing page. You can access Workday anytime through the Link web page: https://link.nebraska.gov/ 
 
 Benefits 
 We offer a comprehensive package of pay, benefits, paid time off, retirement and professional development opportunities to help you get the most out of your career and life. Your paycheck is just part of your total compensation.

Check out all that the State of Nebraska has to offer! Benefit eligibility may vary by position, agency and employment status. For more information on benefits, please visit: https://statejobs.nebraska.gov/index.html#benefits 
 
 
 Equal Opportunity Statement 
 The State of Nebraska values our teammates as well as a supportive environment that strives to promote diversity, inclusion, and belonging. We recruit, hire, train, and promote in all job classifications and at all levels without regard to race, color, religion, sex. age, national origin, disability, marital status or genetics.
